rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing someone who faces fear courageously.

example.english: They are very brave and dare to hike alone at night.
example.traditional: 佢好勇敢，敢一個人喺夜晚行山。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jung5 gam2 gam2 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 je6 maan5 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this when the bravery involves taking risks or acting boldly, sometimes with a hint of recklessness.

example.english: You’re really brave—you actually dared to sing off the cuff on stage.
example.traditional: 你真係大膽，居然夠膽喺台上即興唱歌。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 daai6 daam2 geoi1 jin4 gau3 daam2 hai2 toi4 soeng6 zik1 hing3 coeng3 go1
